# The far hills: a row of five hazy lumps (z up to 2.9), 26 m long, seen against the sky's pink
# glow. Static, behind everything else.
new
material new Haze --base-color 0.2902 0.4784 0.5882 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Far0 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 3.2 1.5 2.4
apply --scale
set location -10.5 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Far1 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 3.6 1.5 2.9
apply --scale
set location -5.5 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Far2 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 3.4 1.5 2.2
apply --scale
set location 0.5 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Far3 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 3.8 1.5 2.7
apply --scale
set location 5.5 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Far4 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 3.0 1.5 2.1
apply --scale
set location 10.5 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05 || normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
material assign Haze
active Far0
join
rename Far0 Far
select all
shade flat
export far.glb
